description: UnclutteredMemory MCP tools (P3). Same handlers as REST: every tool takes a user and is scoped to it. Served by mcp/adapter.py over stdio (tools/list, tools/call).

tools.description: Gate one text and store, drop, or quarantine it for a user. Judge-halted items quarantine, never stub-voted.

source.description: Provenance label for the stored row.

user.description: Owning user scope; required on every call.

tools.name: admit

tools.description: Score stored rows for a user against a query (surface token overlap) and return the gated, capped selection plus a packed string.

user.description: Owning user scope; required on every call.

tools.name: recall

tools.description: Pack cards (or a query scored against stored rows) into a context string within the injector budget. Whole cards only.

cards.description: [text, score] pairs to pack; omit to score query against stored rows.

query.description: Recall query used when cards is omitted.

user.description: Owning user scope; required on every call.

tools.name: inject

tools.description: List the quarantine queue awaiting human triage for a user.

user.description: Owning user scope; required on every call.

tools.name: review
